violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. Bare wood particle board shelving unit not sealed.
Temperature measuring devices. — --Temperature measuring device was not provided. Unable to locate internal thermometers in BOH refrigerators.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Shelving units not maintained. Ensure lower shelves are 6" off floor so as to allow for ease of cleaning and protection from floor contaminants.
Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. Store items a minimum of 6" off floor in BOH area.

Storage areas for refuse, recyclables, and returnables. — --The outside storage surface for holding refuse, recyclables and returnables was not constructed of nonabsorbent material and/or sloped to drain. Dumpster located on gravel lot.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floors have a build up of debris and hair and need cleaning. Floor drains need cleaning.

Control of insects, rodents, and other pests. — --Insects, rodents, or other pests were not controlled in a manner specified in the food service code to minimize their presence within the facility. Drain flies present at floor drain in BOH and FOH.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. Scoops for drink powders stored in containers with handles in product. Invert utensils so handles are up in BOH prep area.
Toilet facilities. — --Toilet room was not provided with a self closing door.

Storage areas for refuse, recyclables, and returnables. — --The outside storage surface for holding refuse, recyclables and returnables was not constructed of nonabsorbent material and/or sloped to drain. Dumpster located South of building located on gravel lot.

General premises. — --Window/door used for ventilation purposes was not properly protected against the entry of insects and rodents. Drive up window kept open for ventilation. Recommend keeping window closed when not in immediate use or install screen.
